author: jaffar21
name: NBAFantasy
short: Play NBAdex Fantasy — an ESPN-style NBA fantasy league — directly in Discord.
description: A fully-featured NBAdex Fantasy cog for Discord: snake drafts, free agency, trades, positional lineups, customizable scoring, live NBA stats/injuries from ESPN, and admin tools. Revamped and ready for the 2026-27 NBA season.
install_msg: Thank you for installing NBAdex Fantasy! Load it with `[p]load nbafantasy`, then run `[p]fantasy setup` to turn it on and `[p]fantasy guide` for the full player guide.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores discord user IDs to keep track of their fantasy teams and league participation.
